title: Prevent from loading old carts
issue_title: Prestashop loads old carts for logged in users
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

**Describe the bug**
When the option "Re-display cart at login" is turned on, and customer has some old abandoned cart, it will get loaded even if the customer also has some never ordered carts.

The cart should be loaded only if it's the last one from the customer's carts.

>Edit by Khouloud

**Steps to reproduce**
1. In the BO => Shop Parameters => Customer Settings => Disable "Re-display cart at login"
2. Go to the FO => login with your customer
3. Add some products to the cart
4. Sign out ( a new line is added to the BO => Shopping carts page)
5. Go to the FO => login with your customer
6. Add some products to the cart
7. Complete checkout
8. In the BO => Shop Parameters => Customer Settings => Enable "Re-display cart at login" again
9. Go to the FO => login with your customer
10. You will have old products in the cart.

title: Frontend Translation mixed up when switching languages

issue_body:
This bug is triggered in various ways i will describe a easily reproducible way here:

- Start with a fresh installation of Prestashop 1.7.6.1
- Add 2 or more additional language packs (German and French in my case)
- Create a customer account
- Change customer firstname to a **invalid** one like "John.P" by direct SQL update
- Log in with the Customer on the Frontend
- Switch between the frontend languages

Now notice how some parts of the page will correctly update languages while others will remain in the previous language.
